name: OCR-Icelandic-benchmark
description: An OCR benchmark focused on Icelandic text that measures optical character recognition systems' ability to transcribe scanned or photographed Icelandic documents accurately. It evaluates robustness to Icelandic-specific characters, fonts, and scanning artifacts and is intended for benchmarking model transcription quality on a low-resource language.
reputation: A specialized dataset for Icelandic OCR with limited but useful adoption among researchers and developers working on Nordic language text recognition.
